risk_if_not_implemented: Without Standardized Operating Procedures (SOP), security, compliance and resilience activities may lack direction, ownership and executive support, leaving required controls unperformed. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Standardized Operating Procedures (SOP) (OPS-04) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the design, implementation, and monitoring of security, compliance and resilience governance controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP) (GOV-02) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Standardized Operating Procedures (SOP) (OPS-04) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
